Assisted living service package starts at $8,245 per month, with costs determined by care need. For assisted living, nonresidents require a one-time refundable entrance deposit of $125,000 to $199,000 under the residence and care agreement, separate from the monthly care package. The checked assisted living page does not state a refund percentage.

The assisted living package lists meals, housekeeping, laundry, cable, use of campus amenities, and a 24-hour assisted living nursing care team. The final package depends on care need.

Memory care publishes $621 per person per day, effective January 2026 and subject to change without notice. Despite the label 'Monthly Service Fee', the stated billing unit is per day. Nonresidents also need an entrance deposit starting at $119,000. Do not treat this as a monthly rate.

Memory care nonresidents pay a one-time 90% refundable entrance deposit starting at $119,000, separate from the $621 per-person daily care charge. The fee section states effective January 2026 and subject to change without notice. Confirm the residence agreement.

For memory care, if the second person does not need memory care, the provider says that person's fee is the second-person base fee plus assessed care need. No dollar amount for that arrangement is published on the checked memory-care page.
Memory care suites have an all-private bedroom with a private half bath. This differs from the private full bath listed for assisted living.

Long-term nursing care publishes a daily cost of $621, separate from a one-time refundable entrance deposit starting at $119,000 for nonresidents. This is a nursing-specific rate, not the independent living package. No effective date is stated on this page.

For long-term nursing care, nonresidents pay a one-time refundable entrance deposit starting at $119,000 under the residence and care agreement, separate from the $621 daily charge. The checked nursing page does not state a refund percentage or effective date.
Long-term nursing care lists all-private suites with a private half bath. Confirm the actual room offered.

The long-term nursing package lists licensed nurses on duty 24/7, medication management, incontinence products and care, meals and snacks, weekly housekeeping, personal laundry, and linen service. Salon services have extra unspecified nominal charges.

facts.text: Holland Christian Home now operates as Windmere. Its current operator page describes residential health care for adults 65 and older, between independent and assisted living. This does not confirm a new life-plan contract or a nursing admission.

Windmere's current residential-health-care offering has no entrance fees and flexible month-to-month rentals. No monthly dollar rent is published on the checked page. These terms do not apply to Mountain View nursing or necessarily to existing lifecare contracts.
The current Windmere residential-health-care page describes private suites. It does not publish a current room-specific dollar rate or availability.

Windmere lists housekeeping and maintenance support, on-site medical professionals, team members available 24/7, and complimentary transportation to Christian Health outpatient services. Confirm which support services are included in the rental quote.
Windmere offers personal tours by request at (201) 932-2376 and links virtual tours of its second-floor Great Room and rooms 216 and 334. A requested visit is not a vacancy or booking confirmation.

Mountain View at Windmere is a separate on-site skilled nursing community with a 24-hour nursing team, private and semi-private suites, and respite stays. Its page publishes a separate tour contact, (973) 816-2697, but no household nursing price.

notes: Checked official pages on 2026-11-13. Rates are published examples, not a personalized quote or evidence of a vacant unit. Campus offerings do not establish the identity, capacity, certification, or clinical score of a separately licensed care unit.

Identity is corroborated by the operator's 2025 audited financial statements naming Holland Christian Home Association dba Windmere, an official Windmere event page at 151 Graham Avenue, and the former hchnj.org site's redirect. Current residential-health-care rental terms are not the historical lifecare agreement or Mountain View nursing rates.

Independent living second-person monthly service fee is $1,635 per month. This is additional to the residence package, not a nursing rate.

Independent living prices are reference prices, not a quote. The provider says its fee schedule changes January 1, 2027 and monthly packages are typically adjusted annually by the board. The checked page does not publish replacement 2027 amounts.

For independent living, the price table and refund FAQ say the entrance fee is 80% refundable under the Residence and Care Agreement. One FAQ on the same page instead says 90%. Confirm the written agreement before relying on a refund percentage.
Independent living Priority List deposit is $1,000 one-time and fully refundable. It provides priority to reserve a residence, not a confirmed vacancy or wait time.

The independent living monthly package includes utilities, heating and air-conditioning, maintenance, scheduled transportation, fitness center and pool, security and emergency response, property taxes, Wi-Fi, phone, and cable TV. These inclusions do not establish continuing-care coverage.
The independent living monthly package includes a meal plan at on-site restaurants. The checked page does not state a meal count.
The campus offers virtual or in-person tours. Request a visit to confirm which residences are available. A tour request is not an opening or reservation.

Assisted living base fees start at $9,408 per month, plus a $5,500 one-time community fee. This is assisted living, not independent living or long-term nursing. Confirm the assessed care package and current quote. No effective date is stated.
Assisted living has a $5,500 one-time community fee, separate from the monthly assisted living base fee starting at $9,408. The checked page does not state refund terms or an effective date.
Assisted living residences have a private full bath, kitchenette, ample closet space, and seamless shower entry. Confirm the specific floor plan.
The assisted living monthly fee includes three daily meals, daily bed-making, weekly housekeeping, one load of laundry weekly, and monthly wellness visits by a licensed nurse.

Memory care private-suite base fee starts at $615 per day, varying by residence and assessed care need. Nonresidents also pay a $5,500 one-time community fee. Although the page calls the package monthly, the published base rate is explicitly daily. No effective date is stated.
Memory care requires a $5,500 one-time community fee for nonresidents, separate from its private-suite base fee starting at $615 per day. Confirm refund terms and assessed care costs.

Long-term nursing care is $615 per day for a private suite, plus a $5,500 one-time community fee for nonresidents. This is a separately published nursing rate, not the independent living package. No effective date is stated.
Long-term nursing care has a $5,500 one-time community fee for nonresidents, separate from the $615 daily private-suite rate. Confirm the current agreement and quote.

The long-term nursing package lists licensed nurses on duty 24/7, medication management, incontinence products and care, meals and snacks, weekly housekeeping, personal laundry, and linen service. Salon services cost extra at unspecified nominal rates.

notes: The operator states that these reference fees change January 1, 2027. Independent living prices apply to apartments on the campus. Continuing-care units have separate pricing.
